rule: Claims are claim-specific. Implementation, reproduction, external validation, production, submission and publication are distinct states.
frozen_outcome_rule: Negative or mixed scientific outcomes are immutable. A changed hypothesis or protocol creates a versioned successor and may not retroactively rescue the original claim.

supported: Frozen ARC validation result is reproducibly negative/inconclusive.
Localized heavy-tail robustness effect and robustness-adaptation failure modes reproduce.
Current successor development gate fails.
Common-adaptation development harness shows the current candidate is worse than strong fixed/confirmed-Huber controls on the key adverse/shift metrics.
Frozen typed/validated pipeline beats frozen direct baseline on controlled held-out-template benchmark.
Valid benchmark cases produce executable non-empty STL.
Reduced-resistance mechanism strongly improves the frozen synthetic pressure-MAE screen.
Robust aggregation effect reproduces in the synthetic contamination protocol.
Frozen equal-budget learned experiment reproducibly misses both adverse-condition superiority gates while passing clean-regression gate.
Controlled rare-event/salience tradeoff reproduces and degrades/reverses under severe salience failure.
Prospective synthetic specificity ablation shows correctly aligned salience improves rare-event MSE over uniform memory while shuffled/distribution-matched random salience erases the measured gain.
unsupported_or_forbidden: architecture superiority over matched learned memory

supported: A separate evidence package exists.
unsupported_or_forbidden: executable/reproduced scientific status inherited from APEN

supported: Real-data comparison reproduces and strong raw/log/spectral/PCA ridge baselines match or beat the method on the frozen primary covariance-matrix MSE.
unsupported_or_forbidden: exact 14899-row historical identity without provenance reconciliation

supported: Controlled coordinate-invariance evidence reproduces.

freeze_contracts.question: Under the frozen ARC-Challenge validation protocol, does the tested LAM-JEPA configuration outperform a matched supervised control and do the planner and target pathways contribute under the preregistered criteria?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: The full system will outperform the matched supervised control and show positive planner and target contributions.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: JEPA-style latent prediction combined with project-specific latent-action/planner/target pathways; component contribution is tested by frozen no-planner and no-target ablations.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Architecture is primarily a combination of established JEPA/latent-action/planning directions; current defensible novelty is the retained negative/reproducibility observation, not a demonstrated new mechanism.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: The frozen ARC result reproducibly does not support superiority, planner benefit or target benefit.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched supervised or ablated controls match/exceed the full system or component effects fail the frozen positive contribution criteria.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: negative-result paper provenance, table/figure regeneration, independent review; no rescue compute

freeze_contracts.question: Under matched prompts/provider/backend/budget, does a typed and validated intermediate representation improve executable CAD reliability and invalid-input handling over competent direct or constrained program generation?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: The structured typed/validated route will materially improve execution, geometry/constraint correctness and unsupported-input rejection without an unacceptable coverage/cost penalty.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: A typed parametric IR plus validation is intended to fail closed and constrain downstream CAD generation before OpenSCAD execution.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Text-to-CAD, parametric programs and programmatic validation are established; current value is a bounded reliability-first compiler formulation and falsifiable execution evidence.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: On the frozen v1 narrow benchmark, typed/validated generation scores 19/20 versus the retained direct baseline 12/20 and produces non-empty STL for all 12 valid cases.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: A matched direct/constrained/retrieval/program-generation baseline closes the material reliability gap or the gain collapses on separately frozen OOD families.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: freeze and run one dangerous-baseline/OOD comparison with component ablations

freeze_contracts.question: At a controlled false-open budget, can an online state estimator adapt to persistent regime change faster and with lower transition/post-change error than strong robust detector-plus-estimator systems without sacrificing isolated-corruption or clean performance?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: A future mechanism is only worth promoting if it beats the frozen robust baseline frontier on recovery/transition/post-change error at comparable false-open behavior.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: The scientific object is the robustness-adaptation tradeoff, separating persistent state change from isolated heavy-tailed corruption; no new successor mechanism is currently authorized.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Robust changepoint detection under outliers/heavy tails is established; a defensible contribution would need an estimator-level false-open/recovery frontier or residual failure not solved by simple detector-plus-estimator systems.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: The current v0.2/PABIM line fails its development promotion gate; robust-change baseline confounds remain unresolved.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: A simple robust detector plus robust estimator matches or dominates the practical false-open/recovery/post-change frontier, eliminating the residual need for a learned successor.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: baseline-frontier development protocol only after methods, false-open constraint/Pareto rule, metrics and stop rule are frozen; confirmatory seeds remain untouched

freeze_contracts.question: Under matched task graphs and provider/resource budgets, does evidence-native orchestration reduce lost work, duplicate execution, unverifiable completion and recovery time after faults relative to a competent orchestration baseline?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Evidence/claim gating plus durable lease/recovery semantics will improve correctness and recovery without merely serializing work or hiding throughput costs.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Durable task/lease state, evidence-gated transitions, provenance, deduplication and crash recovery; scientific contribution remains unproven until real-host comparative evidence exists.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Queues, leases, DAGs, hashes, provider routing and reproducibility bundles are established systems ideas; novelty is deferred pending a precise measured systems effect.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Only bounded design/control evidence is supported now; live host counters and reliability performance are unknown from this surface.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: A simpler competent orchestrator matches correctness/recovery at equal workload/concurrency, or reliability gain disappears after controlling for reduced concurrency.
dangerous_baselines: same Percy workload without evidence gating
same workload under matched conservative concurrency
freeze_contracts.next_gate: non-destructive real Mac DB/WAL/process/lease/heartbeat recovery, then bounded fault matrix

freeze_contracts.question: Does the reduced-resistance representation retain its frozen pressure-MAE advantage against matched learned neural-operator/surrogate baselines and held-out physical regimes?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: The mechanism will remain materially better at matched compute/capacity under held-out/OOD or misaligned fields.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Reduced-resistance representation in the current synthetic Darcy screen.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Current evidence is a bounded synthetic mechanism result, not learned neural-operator superiority or real porous-media generalization.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: The frozen synthetic screen shows a large reproducible pressure-MAE improvement with retained flux check.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: A matched learned/simple reduced-order baseline matches the gain or the effect disappears on held-out physical/OOD regimes.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: freeze learned matched-budget/OOD protocol before additional compute

freeze_contracts.question: Is any adverse-condition memory gain specific to the proposed non-Gaussian learned mechanism rather than generic robust aggregation or standard/reference memory?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: A learned non-Gaussian arm should clear predeclared adverse improvement gates over standard/reference memory at equal capacity without unacceptable clean regression.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: The precursor isolates robust readout effects; NGMT v0.1 separately tests equal-budget learned B0/B1/B2/B3 memory arms.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Robust readouts and memory controls are established; current unique learned mechanism claim is not supported.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Robust-readout precursor is non-unique and NGMT v0.1 misses both frozen adverse superiority gates.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Robust controls explain the effect or B3 fails frozen B1/B2 improvement gates.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: negative-result packaging; any redesign is a separately versioned successor

freeze_contracts.question: Is APEN's rare-event benefit specifically caused by correctly aligned temporal salience and does it persist beyond generic learned memory under realistic salience degradation?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Correct alignment should beat uniform memory, shuffled/random salience should erase the gain, and a matched learned-memory control should not fully explain the effect.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Salience-weighted memory prioritizes temporally aligned rare-event information.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Attention/memory weighting and salience heuristics are established; current evidence supports only bounded alignment specificity in a synthetic task.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Correct salience alignment matters in the current synthetic task; randomization erases the measured rare-event gain.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched learned memory explains the effect or realistic salience corruption removes practical benefit.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: freeze one matched learned-memory + naturalistic salience-quality stress protocol

freeze_contracts.question: Does the eigen/spectral representation improve the frozen primary covariance-matrix forecasting target over strong classical raw/log/PCA/spectral baselines?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Eigen-JEPA should beat the strongest frozen baseline on primary covariance-matrix MSE.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Eigen/spectral representation of covariance dynamics compared with raw, log, PCA and spectral ridge controls.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Spectral decomposition/ridge/PCA are established; current method has not established mechanism or empirical superiority.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Strong classical baselines match or beat the method on the frozen primary metric.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Any competent frozen baseline matches or improves the primary covariance-matrix MSE.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: reconcile row-count provenance and convert negative/mixed result; new multi-dataset work requires a fresh freeze

freeze_contracts.question: Do NPMS functional features contain useful causal/natural-task information beyond coordinate-invariant parameter summaries and competent learned memory controls?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: If the mechanism is unique, it should clear the frozen uniqueness margin and retain value on natural/OOD tasks beyond invariant parameter summaries.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Controlled spectral/memory features with coordinate-invariance diagnostics.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Current broad regime-classification uniqueness is weakened by a strong invariant-parameter control; coordinate-invariance evidence remains bounded and valid.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: NPMS 92.86% versus invariant-parameter 89.29% fails the frozen 5-point uniqueness gate.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Invariant parameter summaries or matched learned controls explain the effect, or transfer fails on a natural/OOD task.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: natural memory task or causal intervention only if it outranks higher-priority closure work
